verdicts.reason: A keeps the structure and reading order intact, but it is mostly a shrink rather than a rearrangement. The three price cards are spread across the canvas with huge gaps, the headline still breaks onto an orphaned 'week', the subcopy and legal text are tiny, and the logo floats in the far left of an off-centre layout. B is broken. The price cards, which carry the offer, are shrunk to illegible thumbnails and scattered out of order (48 and 80 at the top, 6 far below) with the subcopy stranded between them, so the left half reads as random debris. The oversized CTA is also jammed against the right edge.
